name: The Masters
description: Mechanical goblins with giant metal claws fused into the bodies of mechanically modified frog mounts.

timeline.summary: In 4308 Karona travels to Mercadia, meets the mechanical goblin Masters, and kills one who calls Gerrard a saboteur.
timeline.quote: Karona killed that Master and left.
